Summary.en: Joins a begin date/time pair and an end date/time pair into a start and an end value.
Summary.de: Verbindet ein Anfangs-Datum/-Zeit-Paar und ein End-Datum/-Zeit-Paar zu einem Start- und einem Endwert.
Summary.it: Unisce una coppia data/ora iniziale e una finale in un valore di inizio e uno di fine.

Parameter.Begin: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the begin date. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_Begin CSS class.
Parameter.BeginTime: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the begin time. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_Begin_Time CSS class.
Parameter.End: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the end date. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_End CSS class.
Parameter.EndTime: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the end time. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_End_Time CSS class.
Parameter.MsgInvalid: The optional error message shown when the joined end datetime is lower than or equal to the joined begin datetime (defaults to a standard message).

Begin.default: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the begin date. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_Begin CSS class.

BeginTime.default: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the begin time. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_Begin_Time CSS class.

End.default: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the end date. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_End CSS class.

EndTime.default: Optional CSS selector selecting the input that provides the end time. Takes precedence over the CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_End_Time CSS class.

MsgInvalid.default: The end datetime must be strictly after the begin datetime.
